name: response to heat
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a heat stimulus, a temperature stimulus above the optimal temperature for that organism." [GOC:lr]

name: response to temperature stimulus
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a temperature stimulus." [GOC:hb]

name: cellular response to decreased oxygen levels
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus reflecting a decline in the level of oxygen." [GOC:al]

name: cellular response to oxygen levels
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus reflecting the presence, absence, or concentration of oxygen." [GOC:mah]

name: cellular response to hypoxia
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating lowered oxygen tension. Hypoxia, defined as a decline in O2 levels below normoxic levels of 20.8 - 20.95%, results in metabolic adaptation at both the cellular and organismal level." [GOC:mah]

name: response to hypoxia
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating lowered oxygen tension. Hypoxia, defined as a decline in O2 levels below normoxic levels of 20.8 - 20.95%, results in metabolic adaptation at both the cellular and organismal level." [GOC:hjd]

name: chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly
description: "The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a protein complex, mediated by chaperone molecules that do not form part of the finished complex." [GOC:ai]

name: response to oxygen levels
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus reflecting the presence, absence, or concentration of oxygen." [GOC:BHF, GOC:mah]

name: response to decreased oxygen levels
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus reflecting a decline in the level of oxygen." [GOC:al]

name: protein folding
description: "The process of assisting in the covalent and noncovalent assembly of single chain polypeptides or multisubunit complexes into the correct tertiary structure." [GOC:go_curators, GOC:rb]

name: cellular response to stress
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating the organism is under stress. The stress is usually, but not necessarily, exogenous (e.g. temperature, humidity, ionizing radiation)." [GOC:mah]

name: response to abiotic stimulus
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an abiotic (not derived from living organisms) stimulus." [GOC:hb]

name: transition metal ion transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of transition metal ions from one side of a membrane to the other. A transition metal is an element whose atom has an incomplete d-subshell of extranuclear electrons, or which gives rise to a cation or cations with an incomplete d-subshell. Transition metals often have more than one valency state. Biologically relevant transition metals include vanadium, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt, nickel, molybdenum and silver." [ISBN:0198506732]

name: unfolded protein binding
description: "Binding to an unfolded protein." [GOC:ai]

name: iron ion transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of iron (Fe) ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

name: response to stress
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a disturbance in organismal or cellular homeostasis, usually, but not necessarily, exogenous (e.g. temperature, humidity, ionizing radiation)." [GOC:mah]

name: intracellular iron ion homeostasis
description: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of iron ions within a cell." [GOC:ai, GOC:mah]

name: response to stimulus
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus. The process begins with detection of the stimulus and ends with a change in state or activity or the cell or organism." [GOC:ai, GOC:bf]

name: response to iron ion
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an iron ion stimulus." [GOC:sm]

name: perinuclear region of cytoplasm
description: "Cytoplasm situated near, or occurring around, the nucleus." [GOC:jid]

name: protein maturation
description: "Any process leading to the attainment of the full functional capacity of a protein." [GOC:ai]

name: cellular response to stimulus
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus. The process begins with detection of the stimulus by a cell and ends with a change in state or activity or the cell." [GOC:bf, GOC:jl]

name: transition metal ion transport
description: "The directed movement of transition metal ions into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore. A transition metal is an element whose atom has an incomplete d-subshell of extranuclear electrons, or which gives rise to a cation or cations with an incomplete d-subshell. Transition metals often have more than one valency state. Biologically relevant transition metals include vanadium, manganese, iron, copper, cobalt, nickel, molybdenum and silver." [ISBN:0198506732]

name: response to chemical
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a chemical stimulus." [GOC:jl]

name: intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis
description: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of monoatomic cations within a cell. Monatomic cations (also called simple cations) are cations consisting of exactly one atom." [GOC:ceb, GOC:mah]

name: intracellular monoatomic ion homeostasis
description: "A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of monoatomic ions within a cell. Monatomic ions (also called simple ions) are ions consisting of exactly one atom." [GOC:mah]

name: cellular response to chemical stimulus
description: "Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a chemical stimulus." [GOC:mah]

name: heat acclimation
description: "Any process that increases heat tolerance of an organism in response to high temperatures." [GOC:tair_curators]

name: protein stabilization
description: "Any process involved in maintaining the structure and integrity of a protein and preventing it from degradation or aggregation." [GOC:ai]

description: Oxidative phosphorylation

name: metal ion transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of metal ions from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:ai]

name: fraxetin biosynthesis
description: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of fraxetin." [GOC:lr, PMID:29581584]

name: siderophore-dependent iron import pathway
description: "A process in which iron siderophores (low-molecular-weight, high-affinity iron-chelating compounds) are exported to scavenge iron and the iron-loaded siderophores imported back into the cell by transmembrane transport or endocytosis." [GOC:vw]

name: iron ion transport
description: "The directed movement of iron (Fe) ions into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore." [GOC:ai]

name: protein unfolding
description: "The process of assisting in the disassembly of non-covalent linkages in a protein or protein aggregate, often where the proteins are in a non-functional or denatured state." [GOC:mlg]

name: arabinan catabolic process
description: "The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of arabinan, a polysaccharide composed of arabinose residues." [GOC:mlg, ISBN:0198506732]

name: iron coordination entity transport
description: "The directed movement of an iron coordination entity into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore." [GOC:pr, GOC:TermGenie]

name: siderophore-iron import into cell
description: "A process in which iron (Fe3+) is solubilized by ferric iron-specific chelators, known as siderophores is imported into the cell by transmembrane transport or endocytosis." [GOC:vw, PMID:16963626]

name: negative regulation of seed germination
description: "Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of seed germination." [GOC:tb]

name: benzaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: benzaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = benzoate + NADH + H+." [EC:1.2.1.28]

name: 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate pyrophosphatase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate (8-oxo-GTP) + H2O = 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine diphosphate (8-oxo-GDP) + phosphate. 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine triphosphate (8-oxo-GTP) is the oxidised form of the free guanine nucleotide and can act as a potent mutagenic substrate for transcription." [PMID:15878881, RHEA:60032]

name: biotin transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of biotin from one side of a membrane to the other. Biotin is cis-tetrahydro-2-oxothieno(3,4-d)imidazoline-4-valeric acid; the (+) enantiomer is very widely distributed in cells and serves as a carrier in a number of enzymatic beta-carboxylation reactions." [GOC:ai]

name: monoatomic cation transmembrane transporter activity
description: "Enables the transfer of cation from one side of a membrane to the other." [GOC:dgf, GOC:mtg_transport, ISBN:0815340729]

name: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile 4-hydroxylase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile + NADPH +O2=4-hydroxyindole-3- carbonyl nitrile + NADP+ + H20." [GOC:lr, PMID:26352477, RHEA:57864]

name: flavonol 3-O-arabinosyltransferase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: UDP-arabinose + a flavonol = UDP + a flavonol 3-O-D-arabinoside." [PMID:18757557]

name: scopoletin 8-hydroxylase activity
description: "Catalyzes of the reaction: scopoletin + 2-oxoglutarate+O2=fraxetin +succinate+ CO2)." [GOC:lr, PMID:29361149, PMID:29581584, RHEA:57848]

name: dihydroneopterin triphosphate pyrophosphohydrolase activity
description: "Catalysis of the reaction: dihydroneopterin triphosphate = dihydroneopterin phosphate + diphosphate." [RHEA:25302]

description: Endocytosis

description: "Any process that affects the structure and integrity of a protein, altering the likelihood of its degradation or aggregation." [GOC:dph, GOC:mah, GOC:tb]
